children: New Rewards Club gives customers' value for their loyalty and more choice over how they earn boosts and bonuses

NEW YORK, Sept. 1, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- FanDuel, the premier online gaming company in North America, announced a new slate of product experiences coming to FanDuel Sportsbook for the NFL season designed to give customers more control and choice over their rewards while bolstering their in-app research capabilities.

"Our customers look forward to football season, and this year we're giving them more control of their experience to make it the most rewarding season ever," said Karol Corcoran, Managing Director, Sports at FanDuel. "Rewards Club offers those who continue to choose FanDuel Sportsbook more promotions and flexibility in how they use them, and we're also thrilled to bring new research tools and an enhanced version of our popular Bet Protect+ to the NFL."

FanDuel is launching a new sportsbook Rewards Club, a points-based monthly loyalty program designed to recognize customer loyalty, offer more control over how they earn boosts and bonuses and provide more choice on what rewards they want to use once available. Customers can unlock levels as they wager, with each level offering an increasing level of benefits. Features include daily promotions and weekly opportunities to choose a reward, as well as milestone-driven Challenges and new Rewards Boxes that reveal a surprise reward token when customers reach a new level. Together, these features are designed to give customers greater choice and control over how they engage with FanDuel's rewards.
Following strong customer engagement during the NBA Playoffs and throughout the WNBA season, Bet Protect+ will now be available for wagers on NFL games

offering FanDuel customers more control when an injury impacts their player prop bets. For just 3% of a wager, customers can choose to add full-game injury protection. If a player leaves the game due to injury and does not return, customers who enabled Bet Protect+ for a prop wager on the player will receive a cash refund on straight bets or have the affected leg of a parlay removed and the payout recalculated. New for the NFL season, customers will have the option to auto opt-in to Bet Protect+ and can use the feature on bets funded with Bonus Bets. The My Bets page will also show impacted bets in real-time when an injury is confirmed, and customers will receive real-time cash settlement. Bet Protect+ puts choice directly in customers' hands, offering greater flexibility and confidence to decide when to protect their bet.

New and improved game intelligence features offer fans confidence-building tools to assist with bet building throughout the season. Player pages will now feature game logs, offering a full game-by-game breakdown of each player alongside a quick view of the player's performance over the last five games. Fans can also access stats at the team level, including last five games performances, records and standings. Fans can also expect player prop trends, player favoriting, injury reports and league rankings later this season, alongside the introduction of an "Ask AceAI" tab directly to player pages. AceAI is a conversational AI assistant that offers customers stats, available markets and the ability to add selections to their bet slip, all in a single experience. Combined, these new game intelligence features offer customers more information and control throughout the bet building experience.

FanDuel is the premier mobile gaming company in the United States. FanDuel consists of a portfolio of leading brands across mobile wagering including America's #1 Sportsbook, FanDuel Sportsbook; its leading iGaming platform, FanDuel Casino; its new prediction markets platform, FanDuel Predicts; its industry-leading horse racing and advance-deposit wagering, FanDuel Racing; and its daily fantasy sports product. FanDuel has a presence nationwide with offices in New York, Los Angeles, Atlanta and Jersey City, as well as in Canada, Scotland, Ireland, Portugal, Romania and Australia.
